newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads Pakistani for drug smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads Pakistani for drug smuggling.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday beheaded a Pakistani man for smuggling heroin into the kingdom, raising to nine the number of people executed there for drugs charges in May, the official Saudi Press Agency said.

It quoted an Interior Ministry statement as saying the man, the fourth Pakistani to be executed in Saudi Arabia for drugs charges this month, was put to death by the sword after being convicted of smuggling an unspecified amount of heroin.

The execution in the eastern city of Dammam brought the number of beheadings this year to 44 in the conservative kingdom which enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers and rapists.
